label: rem:gravitational-constant-remark
title: Role of the gravitational constant in the field equation
html: The gravitational constant G_q normalises the q-Yang--Mills--Levi variation. It sets the ratio of curvature to stress-energy in the field equation \mathrm{Ric}_{g_\varTheta} = T^{(q)} (GR substrate geometry). In Planck units, G_{\mathrm{Planck}} = G_q\,(\hbar_q/c_q)^2 = 1 identically for all q > 1.
heading: Remark
